verdict.rationale: Bland's own Evals feature uses LLM judges to grade each call along dimensions you define. That gives you AI-generated quality assessments of your call data inside the product. Nothing in the evidence shows broader AI insights or proactive suggestions; analytics querying is exposed only to external agents via the MCP server. Missing for 10: AI-generated recommendations or suggestions, in-product AI insights beyond per-call grading, natural-language analytics inside the product, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Evals let you measure the quality of your calls with LLM judges. You define eval agents, each of which grades one dimension of a call
An evaluation is a judge reading a conversation and saying whether the agent did the thing you wanted.
